title.narrative: Strengthening access to continued and quality care at primary health care centres and dispensaries for vulnerable populations

description.narrative:
Overall objective (impact): To contribute to healthy lives and physical and mental wellbeing of extremely poor and socially vulnerable groups in Lebanon, towards Universal Health Coverage.


Specific objective 1 (outcome): To maintain access to medications at primary health care (PHC) centres and health dispensaries.

Specific objective 2 (outcome): To reinforce the national pharmaceutical sector and supply chain management.

Specific objective 3 (outcome): To strengthen quality of care at PHC.

description.narrative: This project aims to improve access to chronic medications, implement the PeopleCentered Primary Health Care (PCPC) approach, and strengthen digital health systems, contributing to the overall goal of Universal Health Coverage (UHC) in Lebanon. While the specific target for SDG 3.8.1 (universal health coverage, including access to essential health services and affordable medicines) is not the direct responsibility of this project, the initiatives undertaken will support progress toward UHC by ensuring vulnerable populations have access to essential chronic medications and personcentered care. The focus on digitalization will further enhance the efficiency and accessibility of services, helping to address critical gaps in Lebanons healthcare system. Through these interventions, the project will contribute to reducing health inequities and supporting sustainable health systems, in alignment with SDG 3.8.1.p opportunities (partnership analysis).
